title: Diagnostic findings
description: One report from one diagnostic agent (load balancer, Kubernetes, or VCF). Every finding names the tool call that returned its evidence.

incident_id.description: The Zammad ticket number this report is for.

checked_at.description: UTC time the playbook finished, ISO 8601.

status.description: Health of this agent's layer as the tool results show it.

component.description: The thing checked, for example a virtual service, pool member, deployment, pod, host, or datastore.

symptom.description: What the tool result shows, in plain words.

tool.description: The tool that returned this evidence. It must be in tools_used.

raw_value.description: The value exactly as the tool returned it: a string, number, boolean, object, or list.

suspected_cause.description: Null when the layer is healthy.

recommended_action.description: One next step for a person. The agent does not take it.

tools_used.description: Every tool that returned a result.

tools_denied.description: Every tool the playbook needed that was missing or refused.
